# Package `thaumcraft.api.damagesource`

[All packages](README.md)

## DamageSourceIndirectThaumcraftEntity

```java
public final class DamageSourceIndirectThaumcraftEntity
```

The original TC4 indirect damage source.

Oracle `thaumcraft/api/damagesource/DamageSourceIndirectThaumcraftEntity.java:15-35` (CFR 0.152 decompilation of `Thaumcraft-1.7.10-4.2.3.5.jar`): the class extended the 1.7.10 `EntityDamageSourceIndirect`, so a damage source named the direct attacker and the real cause, and it carried the two modifiers of the original: the fire damage and the unblockable damage, the latter also zeroing the hunger damage.

Forced 1.21.1 change: 1.21.1 has no `EntityDamageSourceIndirect` class and its `DamageSource` is a record over a registered damage type and its two entities, so the class became a factory. The two modifiers of the original are properties of the registered damage type in 1.21.1 - the fire tag and the armour bypass with an exhaustion of zero - and the two factories with the original names select a type that carries the property and refuse a type that does not, so an add-on never loses a modifier silently.

<a id="damagesourceindirectthaumcraftentity-setfiredamage"></a>
```java
public static DamageSource setFireDamage(Entity direct, Entity cause, Holder<DamageType> type)
```

Original `func_76361_j` - the fire damage modifier.

The original set the flag of the damage source, so the victim burned. In 1.21.1 the fire damage is the fire tag of the registered damage type, so the type has to carry it.

**Returns:** the damage source with the fire damage

**Parameters:**
- `direct` — the direct attacker
- `cause` — the real cause
- `type` — the registered damage type, it has to carry the fire tag

<a id="damagesourceindirectthaumcraftentity-setunblockable"></a>
```java
public static DamageSource setUnblockable(Entity direct, Entity cause, Holder<DamageType> type)
```

Original `func_76348_h` - the unblockable modifier.

The original set the flag of the damage source and zeroed the hunger damage of it. In 1.21.1 the armour bypass is the armour bypass tag of the registered damage type and the hunger damage is its exhaustion, so the type has to carry both.

**Returns:** the damage source with the unblockable damage

**Parameters:**
- `direct` — the direct attacker
- `cause` — the real cause
- `type` — the registered damage type, it has to bypass the armour and to exhaust nothing

## DamageSourceThaumcraft

```java
public final class DamageSourceThaumcraft
```

Native registry-backed counterparts of the original attributed attacks.

The original published FOUR ready-made sources (oracle `thaumcraft/api/damagesource/DamageSourceThaumcraft.java:19-22`): `taint`, `tentacle`, `swarm` and `dissolve`.

Forced 1.21.1 change: 1.7.10 built a `DamageSource` in the constructor of the class, so the four sources were static fields. 1.21.1 has no such thing: every source is built from a `net.minecraft.core.Holder` of a `DamageType` that lives in the datapack registry. The native port therefore publishes the `ResourceKey` of every type and the factory that returns the ready source of the original. The type ids keep the namespace of the mod, so they never collide with the vanilla ones.

<a id="damagesourcethaumcraft-taint"></a>
```java
public static final ResourceKey<DamageType> TAINT
```

Oracle :19 - the taint poison. It bypasses the armour and it counts as magic damage.

